Kit summary

ArbitramentBasic
Deals 280% DEF DMG to a single enemy and transfers all self debuffs to them. Reduces the target's DEF by 30% for 2 turns if no debuffs are transferred.
Shield of EvilActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 200% DEF DMG to all enemies and removes all of their buffs.
Good and Evil Lv.1Shield of Evil: There is also a 70% chance to reduce all enemies' SPD by 40% for 2 turns.
Light of OrderPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Reduces the Crit DMG taken by all allies by 26% when Elaina survives. When multiple skills increase this attribute, only the strongest one will take effect.
Good and Evil Lv.2Light of Order: Increase the Crit DMG of all allies by the same amount of Crit DMG reduced of all enemies.
Shield of GoodActiveExclusive Lv.3
Cleanses all attribute debuffs of all allies and restores HP by 18% of Max HP to all allies.
Good and Evil Lv.3Shield of Good additionally grants all allies a [Shield] by 30% of Elaina's Max HP for 2 turns.
